notes: Eritrea has no VAT: a sales tax under Proclamation 64/1994 as amended by Proc. 117/2001 (Gazette of Eritrean Laws). Coded rate is the 12% residual rate for goods not in Schedule A (5%) or D (exempt). Caveat: the Gazette scan contains the operative articles but not the substituted Schedules A/D lists, so gold's absence from them is unverified - bullion null. Duty null.

sources.name: Gazette of Eritrean Laws - Proclamation No. 117/2001 amending the Sales and Excise Tax Proclamation, art. 5
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: goods other than those in Schedule A or D bear sales tax at 12 percent; Schedule D goods are exempt
sources.quote: Goods produced locally and goods imported, except goods mentioned under Schedule "A" and Schedule "D" of this Proclamation, at the rate of 12% (twelve percent)
